stops.note: to follow out, to carry out, from ex- and sequi, with irregular past participle executus
stops.meaning: to follow out, to carry out

stops.note: carried into French for carrying out a plan or order
stops.meaning: to carry out a plan or order

stops.note: settled as the English word for carrying out a plan, or putting someone to death by law
stops.meaning: to carry out a plan, or to put someone to death by legal authority

current_meaning: to carry out or put into effect a plan, or to put someone to death by legal authority
